fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Gross Revenues with a minimum of $125/week (approx. $541.67/month). National Advertising Program contribution is currently $75/week per territory (approx. $300/month); can be increased but capped at 1% of weekly Gross Revenues; no increases in first year. Tech fees include BIZTRAX CRM Software at $1,200/year (currently $100/month) and CAD Design Software updates at $70/year. Email address/mailbox fee currently $7-$10/month. Transfer fee is $22,500 or 5% of sales price, whichever is greater. Renewal fee is 25% of then-current initial franchise fee, minimum $14,875. Training fee currently $300/person/day plus travel expenses. Management fee currently $500/day/person plus expenses. Bank charge administrative fee currently $50/occurrence. All fees payable via ACH; royalty and ad fund paid weekly on Monday.
